items.title: SEC Staff Says Token Buybacks Don't Make Crypto a Security—If the Network Works
items.summary: New SEC staff guidance says announcing a token buyback on a functional network isn't a promise that turns the token into a security, a shift one attorney says makes securities laws look "opt-in."

items.title: How Crypto Stopped Waiting for Congress and Learned to Love the Regulators
items.summary: After the Clarity Act failed in the Senate, the SEC, CFTC, and the Fed moved within days to write crypto's rules themselves.
